sloka: अभ्यपद्यन्त संहृष्टाः तेजोवन्तो महाबलाः ।नाना सत्त्व समाकीर्णाम् दैत्य इन्द्र निलय उपमम् ॥४-५०-१२॥
transliteration: abhyapadyanta saṁhṛṣṭāḥ tejovanto mahābalāḥ ।nānā sattva samākīrṇām daitya indra nilaya upamam ॥4-50-12॥

translations.english: The cave was crowded with creatures of different kinds. It looked like the abode of the king of demons difficult (to enter), dreadful and impenetrable.
